menuClickSequence.note: PLACEHOLDER - Main Play/Solo button (center-ish). Update for your resolution.
PLACEHOLDER - Confirm/Start button. Update for your resolution.

notes: menuNavMode: 'auto' uses menuClickSequence (coordinates as % of window). 'assisted' prompts user.
xPct/yPct are percentages of window width/height (0-100). 50/50 = center.
Key codes: M=0x4D, TAB=0x09, RETURN=0x0D, ESCAPE=0x1B, SPACE=0x20
For TAB: holdMs controls how long the key is held down before release.
Increase waitMenuSeconds if your machine is slow to load REPO.
Increase waitLevelLoadSeconds if level takes a long time to generate.
